metadata.short_desc: Inspect context usage and compression count per conversation in the WebUI
metadata.desc: Inspect context usage and compression counts for every conversation in the AstrBot WebUI, with an in-chat context query, search, sorting and light/dark themes.

enable_chat_command.hint: Wake the bot and send "context" (case-insensitive) to get the current conversation's context usage without calling the LLM.

auto_refresh_enabled.hint: When enabled, the dashboard refreshes automatically at the configured interval; when disabled, use the Refresh button.

auto_refresh_interval.hint: Defaults to 15 minutes, range 1-120. Only used when auto refresh is enabled.

dashboard.title: Context Dashboard
dashboard.description: Context usage and compression counts for every conversation.
dashboard.heading: Context Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Context usage and compression counts per conversation
dashboard.search_placeholder: Search conversations, titles, sessions or IDs…
dashboard.loading_cached: Showing cached data, updating in background…
dashboard.compression_threshold_hint: Context compression triggers at about 82% (AstrBot default)
dashboard.empty_hint: Once AstrBot handles a conversation, its context usage shows up here.
dashboard.truncated: Too many conversations; showing the most recent ones.
